scientific_integrity: The result is proved analytically and checked by independently executable exact arithmetic. No independent scientific audit or publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to continuous-time one-step gain–loss birth–death rates abstracted from the published four-person coefficients, for integer population N>=6 and 0<p<1. It is not a theorem for simultaneous multiagent flips, transient dynamics, other topologies or publication priority. The source appeared in a 2022 journal issue; 2022-12-14 is the earliest exact calendar day verified for a publicly uploaded complete source copy, not a claim that there was no earlier publication.
title: Strict finite-population polarization ordering in four-person majority gain–loss dynamics
